# SpaceXAI Ambassadors

![SpaceXAI](../../assets/companies/spacexai.png)

I joined Cursor's community program as Madrid Ambassador in May 2025. I later served as **Cursor Community Regional Lead for Europe**, supporting meetups, cafes, hackathons, workshops, and founder groups.

After Cursor [joined SpaceX](https://cursor.com/blog/joining-spacex), the program became **SpaceXAI Ambassadors**. I now organize Grok Bot meetups for the next chapter. [SpaceXAI Ambassadors on LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/spacexai-community).

The event log keeps the original Cursor names for meetups and hackathons that happened before the change. It separates events I **organized**, events Cursor **sponsored**, and events I **attended** as a guest.

organized_events.title: SpaceXAI Ambassadors
organized_events.body_md: After Cursor [joined SpaceX](https://cursor.com/blog/joining-spacex), the community program became **SpaceXAI Ambassadors**. Grok Bot meetups are the next format.

organized_events.title: Café Cursor A Coruña
organized_events.body_md: First Cursor event in **Galicia**, all day at **La Terraza by Finisterre**. Hosted with **Jorge Teixeira** and **Juanjo do Olmo**; **David Gomes** (morning) and **Luís Tavares** (afternoon) from the SpaceXAI team flew in for Q&A on Grok Bot, Grok 4.6, and the editor roadmap. 139 confirmed, 105+ attended (about 60 to 65 in the morning session). Coffee and pastry were free; local merch covered a customs delay. People came from Madrid, Jaén, across Galicia, and a few from Belgium.

organized_events.body_md: First Cursor Community event outside Madrid. Hosted with **Juan Lopez Salaberry** at **Aethos Club Palma**: a short Cursor masterclass, community demos, and networking. Cursor credits for check-ins.

organized_events.title: Cursor Madrid Hackathon #3
organized_events.body_md:
Hosted with **Juan Mugica Gonzalez** and **Xuban Ceccon** in Chamberí. About 130 people. Theme: ship the most fun project possible with Cursor, with a focus on computer vision (Canvas, video, images) and LibreYOLO for body-tracking demos.

**Winners**

1. **Mog Off**. Splitscreen minigames in the style of the PS2 EyeToy.
2. **MemeBongo**. Drums and music played with body movement.
3. **Meme Ninja**. Fruit Ninja with memes, controlled by body tracking.

organized_events.title: Cursor Community Regional Lead (Europe)
organized_events.body_md: Became **Cursor Community Regional Lead for Europe**. I supported local organizers and helped connect events across the region.

organized_events.title: 2nd Cursor Meetup
organized_events.body_md:
Hosted with **Tinybird** and **Kfund**. Talks from both teams led into product demos and hallway conversations.

- getshell.ai showed shell-based agent workflows with OpenClaw.
- Cursor showed Cloud Agents and the [onboarding flow](https://cursor.com/onboard).

organized_events.title: Café Cursor
organized_events.body_md:
An all-day coworking session at **eito**. People worked on their own projects and asked Cursor engineers for debugging help. There was no stage or talk schedule.

The cafe had a main workspace, a quieter back room, and an upstairs area.

organized_events.title: Cursor Hackathon × HappyRobot × Kibo Ventures
organized_events.body_md:
The challenge was to integrate a HappyRobot AI agent into a working product using Cursor.

**Winners**

1. **TravelBot** handled corporate stays, transport, and dining.
2. **MedTracker** called elderly relatives for daily medication check-ins.
3. **Santa's Call** called children about their behavior and wish lists.

organized_events.title: First Cursor Hackathon (Madrid)
organized_events.body_md:
Hosted with **Enzo Ventures**, **OneCoWork**, and **productmakers.ai**. Teams had about two hours to build a gamified product with Cursor.

**Winners**

1. **RoomieScore** covered chores, expenses, and co-living for roommates.
2. **FocoQuest** turned personal tasks into missions and progression.
3. **FinPlay** made personal finance visual.

organized_events.title: First official Cursor meetup (Madrid)
organized_events.body_md: Hosted at **Google for Startups Madrid** with **Takos**. Community lightning talks and project demos from attendees.

organized_events.title: Cursor Madrid Ambassador
organized_events.body_md: Joined the community program as **Cursor Madrid Ambassador** and began organizing meetups and workshops with local coworkings and universities.

sponsored_events.title: Cursor x TechIE Hackathon | IE University
sponsored_events.body_md: TechIE and Cursor brought a student hackathon to an IE University auditorium. The room filled with teams building in Cursor.

sponsored_events.title: Refugio Madrid 2026
sponsored_events.body_md: A Saturday at Matadero Madrid with morning talks, a hackathon of about 15 teams, and an afternoon community session. Cursor sponsored the event. Speakers came from NVIDIA, Microsoft AI, Maisa AI, THEKER Robotics, ELLIS Madrid and UC3M, Capchase, and Kibo Ventures.

sponsored_events.title: HackSpain 2026
sponsored_events.body_md: A three-day Madrid hackathon for more than 300 builders, with a machine-learning track with free compute and a non-technical track for first-time builders. Cursor sponsored it. A live leaderboard in the hall tracked tokens, GitHub pushes, agent sessions, and pull requests per team, and passed 43 billion tokens during the event. The mafer.ai team took the overall prize of €5,000. [Video of the event](https://x.com/hackspain26/status/2102035919440150624/video/1).

attended_events.title: Compile London
attended_events.body_md: Invited guest at [Compile London](https://cursor.com/compile/london), Cursor's Compile on the Road day of talks, demos, and conversation. Sessions covered AI deployments at scale, chalk talks (including David Gomes), shipping velocity, and a Grok Bot workshop, followed by a networking reception.
